hack100.attackDamage: Damage: tens digit of the roll {bonus}

hints.roll: Click: roll right away. Shift+click: roll dialog (modifier, luck, SP).
hints.specialism: Click: roll right away (needs at least 1 SP). Shift+click: roll dialog (modifier, luck, SP to spend).
hints.weapon: Click: attack right away, damage rolled on a hit. Shift+click: roll dialog. Right click: open the sheet.
hints.armor: Click: equip or remove. Right click: open the sheet.
hints.consumable: Click: use (removes 1 from the quantity and posts it to chat). Right click: open the sheet.
hints.item: Click: show the item in chat. Right click: open the sheet.
hints.experience: Click: experience roll. Above the current value, it improves by 1d5.
hints.initiative: Rolls initiative and adds the token to combat if needed.
